title: Burford promotes Travis Lenkner and Carrie Tendler, reports CDR
summary: CDR reports that Burford Capital has promoted Chief Development Officer Travis Lenkner to Chief Operating Officer and elevated Special Counsel Carrie Tendler to Managing Director and Head of Asset Recovery. CEO Christopher Bogart says the pair “have quickly established themselves as strong business leaders,” as Burford continues to expand its leadership bench across key areas of the business. Learn more.
body_markdown:
CDR reports that Burford Capital has promoted Chief Development Officer[Travis Lenkner](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/travis-lenkner/) to Chief Operating Officer and elevated Special Counsel[Carrie Tendler](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/carrie-tendler/) to Managing Director and Head of Asset Recovery. CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) says the pair “have quickly established themselves as strong business leaders,” as Burford continues to expand its leadership bench across key areas of the business.


Read the full article[here](https://www.cdr-news.com/categories/people-firms/friday-round-up-london-firms-lure-lots-of-litigators/) .
